alt.en: A wide mesh of seven connected spheres, one of them blue, stands at the center of a gray floor. A dotted gray line joins it to a three-bar chart with one blue bar on the left, and a dashed blue arrow runs from the mesh to a standing picture card on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央是由七个相连小球组成的网络，其中一个为蓝色。左侧是三根柱子的柱状图，其中一根为蓝色，以灰色点线与网络相连；一条蓝色虚线箭头从网络指向右侧立着的图片卡。

caption.en: Illustration: a graph of connected nodes stands for the map of a foundation model's ancestry the paper describes, with bars for the dependency counts the authors report and a picture card for the released maps; it does not depict a tested deployment, the real maps or their contents.
caption.zh: 示意图：相连的节点网络代表论文所描述的基础模型来源图谱，柱状图代表作者报告的依赖数量，图片卡代表已发布的地图；图中并未描绘经过测试的实际部署，也不是真实的地图或其内容。
